source_revision: Shopify GraphQL Admin API 2026-10 (latest stable per shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/versioning on 2026-11-01; 2025-10 is listed unsupported)
identity_rule: provider_event_id = "<shop>|bt:<numeric id>|refund"; record id refund:ledger:<id>; economic_effect_id = shopify:transaction:<sourceOrderTransactionId> (shared with shopify.refunds so one refund is never two debits).
coverage_rule: Balance transactions of type REFUND in the window; pending/failed refunds are not visible in the ledger (see shopify.refunds).

retention.basis: Shopify API License and Terms of Use, merchant-owned data, read-only custom app; the merchant owns its order/payout data and installs the app on its own store. Raw provider payloads are stored as sanitized evidence (no customer names/emails/addresses) under the workspace retention policy.

refund_id.normalization: "ledger:<balance transaction id>"; the shop Refund gid is reachable through the shared economic_effect_id.

original_transaction_id.missing_behavior: null when absent (refund not linkable; kept as ledger posting only).

status.normalization: Constant "completed": a REFUND ledger posting is a settled provider movement.

destination.normalization: Constant "original_payment_method" (the ledger refunds the card/payment method).
destination.missing_behavior: Constant; gift-card refunds never appear in the Shopify Payments ledger.

economic_effect_id.normalization: shopify:transaction:<sourceOrderTransactionId> or the balance transaction identity when unlinked.

event_rules.unsupported_reason: The provider ledger only shows settled postings; pending refunds come from shopify.refunds.

event_rules.rule: REFUND posting: cash out on the provider balance; deduplicated with the shop refund by economic_effect_id.

event_rules.unsupported_reason: Failed refunds never post to the ledger; see shopify.refunds.
No refund reversal posting type is verifiable in the pinned enum offline; unknown types are kept as provider.ledger_posted with their type string.

synchronization.initial_import: Backfill reads shopifyPaymentsAccount.balanceTransactions with the query filter processed_at:>=requested_from AND processed_at:<=initial_cutoff, first=50, Relay cursor pagination; the provider gives no exact count, so totals stay unknown (counts/phase shown instead of a percentage).
synchronization.cursor: Incremental: processed_at:>=floor where floor = max(previous floor, min(newest processed_at seen, now) - 3600 s); page cursor = Relay endCursor. Same connection as provider_ledger; see its limitations.
synchronization.reconciliation: Every 24 h (and once after sleep/wake, bounded to 7 days) re-read the window; deduplicated by provider_event_id.
synchronization.deduplication: provider_event_id = "<shop numeric id>|<object>:<numeric id>|<state>"; identical content duplicates, differing content conflicts (review case). Economic identity: sourceOrderTransactionId links a ledger entry to the shop transaction; adjustments without a source keep their own identity.
synchronization.freshness: Default poll every 1800 s (300 s to 24 h, jitter 120 s); successful-check and new-event timestamps are separate; payout status is a provider assertion until bank evidence (bank_csv) confirms it.

local_standalone.schedule: Poll every 1800 s (bounds 300 s-24 h, jitter 120 s); reconciliation every 24 h over 7 days.
local_standalone.history_limit: Account history as exposed by the pinned API; the exact retention of balance transactions on the account is not verifiable offline and is recorded from the live account at SLICE-02/SOURCE-01 time.
local_standalone.authentication: Admin API access token for a merchant-installed custom app (X-Shopify-Access-Token), or the Dev Dashboard client-credentials grant (POST /admin/oauth/access_token, 24h token, refreshed one minute before expiry, no redirect URL). The token is stored encrypted on the connection (AES-256-GCM, key outside the database) and never logged. Additionally requires an active Shopify Payments account (shopifyPaymentsAccount.activated) and the read_shopify_payments_payouts scope (view_payouts permission); disputes need read_shopify_payments_disputes.
local_standalone.recovery: Provider cursor and phase are persisted per page in import_runs.checkpoint / capability_health.*_cursor after COMMIT; a failed page never advances the checkpoint. Expired cursors restart the current phase from its floor (idempotent through the deliveries dedupe boundary). 401/403 stop polling with status reauthorization_required/degraded; 429 waits for Retry-After (fallback 1 s); 5xx retry with exponential backoff (max 5 attempts) then the run is re-queued with backoff; non-retryable failures become visible dead letters. After sleep/wake one coalesced poll per poll group plus one bounded overlap reconciliation (gap + overlap, capped at the reconcile window) is scheduled; no burst replay.
local_standalone.limitations: Same connection as provider_ledger; see its limitations.
local_standalone.reason: Outbound polling of the Shopify Payments account works for the declared subset; missing fields keep the capability partial.

local_gateway.limitations: No gateway runtime exists in the pilot; declared and refused by the connector (LOCAL-07).
local_gateway.reason: local_gateway is deferred scope for the local pilot (delivery-profile.json); no gateway is provisioned and the capability declaration lists no methods for it.

public_server.limitations: No public callback is registered; localhost cannot receive Shopify webhooks.
public_server.reason: public_server is deferred scope for the local pilot; direct webhooks would require a public HTTPS endpoint that the pilot does not provide.

import_readiness.historical_availability: Balance transactions and payouts as far back as the account exposes them; the exact depth is not verifiable offline and is recorded from the authorized account (blocked_external until then).
import_readiness.open_and_related_records: The refunded order is an optional link; no traversal.
import_readiness.opening_state: Account balance snapshots (positions) are the opening state as of the poll time; they are never summed with ledger movements.
import_readiness.progress_accounting: Counted within the ledger poll (same provider query).
import_readiness.readiness_rules: Refund cash questions are ready when both shop and ledger refunds are current; partial when ledger postings lack sourceOrderTransactionId.
import_readiness.data_handling: Only gids, amounts, types, statuses and timestamps; no bank account numbers (bankAccounts is not queried).
